author: /root/profile_parent_final_audit
decision: Scratch component proposal, requires independent review/runtime before integration
api: refreshUnitFallbackReferences(host, readonly {id,name}[]) => boolean; returns false for missing/disconnected component, malformed/duplicateID snapshot. No GET or write; owning parent supplies validated current snapshot.
behavior: WeakMap lifecycle entry deleted when component remount starts; entry installed after initial confirmed fallback GET renders. No global listener, new network request or retry in helper.

Updates existing owner headings, target names/rank text and action aria labels without replacing dirty row/control nodes. Existing selected fallback option retained explicitly unavailable if removed from latest snapshot.
Saved/draft Maps and order remain untouched. Returned snapshot updates name map and membership used for subsequent user-triggered repaint, preventing old labels reappearing.

Missing draft targets retain immutable IDs and last-known text with explicit unavailable wording. Existing Save payload and authoritative server validation remain unchanged. Add cannot use a target absent from current validated reference snapshot; selecting another valid option enables existing Add.

New returned target Units appear as choices for existing owner rows. New owner rows are not fabricated because confirmed fallback assignment state for them has not been returned. A later existing fallback GET readback must reconcile those rows without replacing unrelated dirty maps.
integration_notes: Import symbol alongside renderUnitFallbacks in main only when corresponding registry retained pipeline is implemented. Call with exact owned validated Unit references after successful relevant read; no blind call from stale callback.

Current Unit management snapshot may not be complete registry membership (active/month-scoped); snapshot completeness must be declared by caller. Do not mark a Unit unavailable solely due to applying a deliberately filtered display list. Prefer existing normalization units response with known inclusion semantics or full registry snapshot.
No claim this helper fixes original159 or registry create/edit lifecycle by itself. Parent full render must first be replaced by retained coordinator.

Independent tests: real dirty order3units, rename/create/remove targets, retained selected option/focus, subsequent reorder retains new label, save payload equality, busy row heldPUT, superseded snapshot owner, malformed snapshot no DOM mutation.
limits: No browser execution, no application changes, no endpoint/policy/scheduling/export edits.
Initial V1 intentionally retained as exploratory source with known repaint/selection limitations; V2 is current proposal only.
Snapshot guard checks structural id/name and uniqueness; membership policy/completeness belongs to confirmed existing endpoint semantics and owner, not new frontend assumptions.
